title: MQTT Configuration
description: Configure MQTT broker connections and the topics traced

brokers.title: Brokers
brokers.description: MQTT brokers to trace. Click 'Add' to add a broker, or use Auto-configure to check the brokers here (none: it looks for brokers on this machine).

name.title: Name
name.description: Label this broker appears under in the trace and the `broker` parameter of the actions. Defaults to the host (e.g. localhost, 192_168_1_10).

host.title: Host
host.description: Broker host name or IP address

port.title: Port
port.description: 1883 is plain MQTT, 8883 MQTT over TLS

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Topic filters to subscribe to (`+` one level, `#` the rest). Without a device map every topic received is traced as an event named after it; a device map's topics are subscribed too, and traced as its events. Clear to trace only the device map's topics.

device_map_file.title: Device Map File
device_map_file.description: JSON file mapping topics to typed, named fields grouped into events. Leave empty to trace every topic as received.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: MQTT client identifier. Leave empty for a generated one.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: Connect over TLS, verifying the broker's certificate and host name. A failed check stops the connection; it never falls back to plain MQTT.

ca_file.title: CA File
ca_file.description: CA certificate (PEM) that signed the broker's certificate. Leave empty to use Advanced > CA File, else the system trust store.

cert_file.title: Client Certificate
cert_file.description: Client certificate (PEM) the broker maps to a user (mutual TLS). Leave empty to use Advanced > Client Certificate. Set together with Client Key.

key_file.title: Client Key
key_file.description: Unencrypted private key (PEM) for the client certificate.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Settings shared by every broker, and the defaults a broker inherits.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Leading trace source every broker publishes under, so events read '<prefix>/<broker>/<event>'. Clear it to give each broker its own trace source with unprefixed events.

retry_unreachable_at_start.title: Retry Unreachable at Start
retry_unreachable_at_start.description: Off: a broker that cannot be connected at start stops the extension. On: it logs an ERROR and is retried like a dropped connection while the other brokers trace.

keepalive.title: Keepalive (seconds)
keepalive.description: MQTT keepalive: the broker drops a client silent for 1.5x this, and the client a broker that does not answer its pings.

ca_file.title: CA File
ca_file.description: Default CA certificate (PEM) for TLS brokers that leave theirs empty. Empty: the system trust store.

cert_file.title: Client Certificate
cert_file.description: Default client certificate (PEM) for TLS brokers that leave theirs empty. Set together with Client Key.

key_file.title: Client Key
key_file.description: Unencrypted private key (PEM) for the default client certificate.
